hero.title: Learn it. Teach it. Build it. Show it.
hero.sub: Synapse is a learning centre in Chamba that brings students, graduates, readers and builders together under one roof so people take turns learning, teaching, and building.
hero.analogy: AI is the encyclopaedia; Synapse is the gym and the workshop.
hero.strip: A modern gurukul for the age of AI. Learn, teach and build, under one roof.

problem.label: THE PROBLEM
problem.title: Three worlds that never meet.
problem.lead: Education in our districts is broken into three separate spheres that do not talk to each other.

threeWorlds.name: School
threeWorlds.summary: A syllabus and a certificate, but no individual attention.
threeWorlds.breakdown: Classrooms move at one rigid pace. Teachers must finish textbook chapters rather than ensure deep understanding, leaving children with credentials but fragile fundamentals.

threeWorlds.name: Coaching
threeWorlds.summary: Exam tricks and rote drill, rarely independent thinking.
threeWorlds.breakdown: Mass coaching factories drill pattern recall for entrance tests. They train students to guess quickly rather than reason from first principles, and discard those who do not fit the mold.

threeWorlds.name: Innovation
threeWorlds.summary: Happens elsewhere, draining local talent to distant metros.
threeWorlds.breakdown: Real engineering, research, and enterprise happen far away in big cities. District youth believe they must leave their homes and families just to access serious mentorship and modern tools.

problem.conclusion: Nothing connects them. Synapse bridges this gap by putting learners, teachers, and builders under one roof.

loop.label: THE SYNAPSE LOOP
loop.title: The four-part cadence: learn, teach, build, show.
loop.lead: True understanding is not completed when an exam answer is marked correct. It is sealed when you can teach it to another and build something real with it.

steps.name: Learn
steps.action: Learn it down to the roots.
steps.detail: Deconstruct concepts to first principles before memorizing formulas. Understand why a law of physics or a theorem holds true before applying it.

steps.name: Teach
steps.detail: Explaining a concept to a peer or a younger learner reveals gaps instantly. You do not truly understand an idea until you can teach it simply.

steps.name: Build
steps.detail: Apply your knowledge to working circuits, code, written essays, or physical models. Connect textbook theory to practical creations.

steps.name: Show
steps.detail: Present your work to peers, parents, and visitors. Defend your findings, accept critique, and leave with marks and a body of work.

principlesIntro.label: WHAT WE STAND FOR
principlesIntro.title: Eight principles that govern our work.
principlesIntro.sub: A child ends a term with marks and a body of work.

notList.label: WHAT WE REFUSE TO BECOME
notList.title: Defined as clearly by what Synapse is not.
notList.sub: Negative definitions guard the integrity of the institution.

items.title: Not a coaching mill
items.refusal: We do not herd hundreds of students into tiered lecture factories to drill multiple-choice tricks.
items.instead: We teach in small groups where a guide knows every student personally, tests daily on what was just taught, and solves doubts individually.

items.title: Not a software app with a classroom
items.refusal: AI is an infinite encyclopaedia and practice engine, not an institutional substitute.
items.instead: Software assists with practice and spaced revision, but a human guide, a real desk, a shared chalkboard, and a physical community are non-negotiable.

items.title: Not an accelerator that sells equity
items.refusal: We do not demand equity from young founders or push venture-scale hype on local soil.
items.instead: The top floor offers desks and community to local founders and builders in exchange for teaching and mentoring children; the exact commitment is agreed per founder.
